nodes.label: Sprint 11 — UX y funcionalidad
nodes.rationale: Standardized visit creation into a single modal (title+date+plantilla) and added contextual breadcrumb 'Volver' navigation to replace inconsistent per-page back links.

nodes.label: Sprint 12 — Seguridad, colaboracion y robustez
nodes.rationale: Fixed mapaHtml XSS by sandboxing the iframe without allow-same-origin, added zone-based IDOR checks across proyectos/visitas/comentarios/fases/contactos, and introduced real-time collaborative presence via a new /api/presence endpoint.

nodes.label: Sprint 13 — Calidad y testing
nodes.rationale: Reached Lighthouse 100/100/96/100 and added 18 Playwright E2E tests plus full dark-mode coverage across drawers/modals — established the quality baseline referenced later in AGENTS.md section 7.

nodes.label: Sprint 15 (archive) — Tags, Menciones y Grupos
nodes.rationale: Introduced the Tag/VisitaTag/ProyectoTag pivot model and @MentionInput/MentionText components later reused unmodified by NotaEquipo notes (Sprint 16) and incidencias comments — a deliberate reuse-over-rebuild decision.

nodes.label: Sprint 17 (archive) — Favoritos, Equipo, Excel, Notificaciones, iCal
Sprint 18 (archive) — Heatmap, Alertas HW, Firma digital, Llamadas
Roadmap corporativo Fases 1-9 (seguridad/BD/Redis/paginacion/Zod/code-splitting/JWT)
nodes.rationale: A 9-phase corporate hardening roadmap completed pre-Sprint-20: brute-force login limiting, CSP without unsafe-eval, HSTS, connection pooling max:20, 15 FK indexes, Upstash Redis for rate-limit/presence, pagination for hospitales/proyectos, centralized Zod validation across ~50 routes, code-splitting proyectos/[id] from 4902 to 300 lines, and JWT revocation checked every 5 minutes.

nodes.label: Ideas de features — Sesion junio 2026 (12 propuestas priorizadas)
nodes.rationale: The original brainstorm (plantillas inteligentes, notas de equipo, timeline global, scoring hospitales, briefing matutino, modo presentacion, quick actions, comparador de periodos, pasaporte hardware, resumen semanal, ruta optimizada, check-in/check-out) that AGENTS.md later marks item-by-item as IMPLEMENTADO across Sprints 16-21 — this node is the source plan those sprints executed against.
